# World region: region (REGN)

A World Bank region: its countries, population, life expectancy, women in parliament, Internet use and the government types found in it. One row per world region, keyed by REGION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (table `<root>/civic/region/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/region.jsonl`, 7 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/region.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `REGION_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REGION_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^REGN-` | `"REGN-EAS"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | A World Bank geographic region. | — | `"East Asia & Pacific"` |
| `COUNTRIES` | integer | required | The number of countries of the region in the pack. | — | `37` |
| `POPULATION_M` | number | required | The region's total population (World Bank aggregate). | unit: millions | `2390.87` |
| `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` | number | required | Years a newborn would live at current mortality (World Bank aggregate). | unit: years | `76.7379` |
| `YEAR` | string | required | The year of the figures. | — | `"2024"` |
| `INTERNET` | number | required | The share of the population that used the Internet in the last three months. | unit: % of population | `88.4` |
| `WOMEN_PARLIAMENT` | number | required | The share of parliamentary seats held by women (Inter-Parliamentary Union, via the World Bank). | unit: % of seats | `23.3498` |
| `URBAN` | number | required | Urban population as a share of the total (World Bank). | unit: percent, in points | `64.771` |
| `LIFE_TREND` | array of objects | required | Life expectancy at birth across the region by year, one element per year: YEAR and VALUE in years (World Bank). | — | [10 objects] |
| `LIFE_TREND[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `LIFE_TREND[].VALUE` | number | required | Years at birth in that year. | unit: years | `75.7926` |
| `INTERNET_TREND` | array of objects | required | Internet use across the region by year, one element per year: YEAR and VALUE in % of population (World Bank). | — | [11 objects] |
| `INTERNET_TREND[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `INTERNET_TREND[].VALUE` | number | required | Share of the population using the Internet in that year. | seen: `20`, `22`, `29`, `35`, `46`, `48`, `80`; unit: % of population | `48.3` |

| `GOVERNMENT_TYPES[].TYPE` | string | required | The form of government as the CIA World Factbook words it. | — | `"parliamentary republic"` |
| `GOVERNMENT_TYPES[].COUNT` | integer | required | How many countries of the region have this government type. | — | `5` |
| `MEMBER_STATES` | array of strings | required | The region's countries: ids of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). | links to `jurisdiction` | [37 values] |

| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 7 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `REGION_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `REGION_ID`, `NAME`, `COUNTRIES`, `POPULATION_M`, `LIFE_EXPECTANCY`, `YEAR`, `INTERNET`, `WOMEN_PARLIAMENT`, `URBAN`, `LIFE_TREND`, `INTERNET_TREND`, `GOVERNMENT_TYPES`, `MEMBER_STATES`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `REGION_ID` per snapshot.
- `REGION_ID` matches `^REGN-`.
- `GOVERNMENT_TYPES[].COUNT` is at least 0.
